The Stylist

About Derickus

Born and raised in Charlotte, Derickus Crawford has spent 20 years turning hair into art. A master stylist featured in Essence magazine, he is known for dramatic cuts, fearless color and styling that turns heads the moment you walk in the room.

20Years Experience
4.5 ★88 Reviews
ESSENCEMagazine Feature

His Philosophy

Every client who sits in the chair gets a look built for her face, her life and her confidence. No copy and paste styles. No playing it safe when the moment calls for bold.

From sculpted updos to vivid pixies to sleek bobs, the range is the point. One chair. Every kind of beautiful.

What He Does Best

Services
